'''I Shot the Sheriff''' was a challenge planned for the [[Social Club|Rockstar Social Club]] shortly after the game's release in 2010, however the original challenge was scrapped. The original reward for completing the challenge was to unlock the eight playable Marshal [[Multiplayer Characters|multiplayer characters]] in the [[Outfitter]]. These characters were subsequently unlocked for everyone without the challenge.

In lieu of this challenge and another scrapped challenge titled "Skin It to Win It", Rockstar instead started an [[XP]] challenge on January 18, 2011 with the reward of unlocking Xbox LIVE and PlayStation Home avatars. The announcement of this challenge, including a reference to the two scrapped challenges is in [http://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/12991/red-dead-redemption-rockstar-xp-challenge-now-available-pitch-in.html this Rockstar Newswire article].

==Trivia==
*The name is most likely a reference to the Bob Marley song, "''[[wikipedia:I_Shot_the_Sheriff|I Shot the Sheriff]]".''
